title: Functions, Scales, and Mathematical Modeling
summary: A mathematically precise starting course for algebraic functions, quantities, scaling, exponential and periodic behavior, and responsible fitting from data. Designed to prepare listeners for calculus, statistics, numerical modeling and differential equations.
assumed_background: Arithmetic, fractions, school algebra, and coordinate graphs; individual lectures introduce other tools as needed.

lectures.title: Functions and Scales: Inputs, Models, and Dimensional Reasoning
lectures.description: Establishes domains, units, inverses and composition, then develops power-law scaling, dimensional checks and model regimes.

lectures.title: Exponential Growth, Logarithms, and the Meaning of a Rate
lectures.description: Compares additive and multiplicative growth, derives logarithmic inverse questions, compounding, continuous-rate decay, and saturation.

lectures.title: Trigonometry as Rotation, Motion, and Signal
lectures.description: Introduces sine and cosine through rotations, defines amplitude/frequency/phase, and demonstrates a sampling ambiguity.

lectures.title: From Data Points to a Predictive Function
lectures.description: Works an exactly interpolating quadratic against a least-squares line and develops residual criticism, extrapolation and prediction testing.
